atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Use the @tailwind directive to inject Tailwind's base, components, utilities and other layers into your CSS.

atDirectives.name: @layer
atDirectives.description: Use @layer to define cascade layers in CSS.

atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Use @theme to define your design tokens (colors, spacing, fonts, etc.) as CSS custom properties for Tailwind CSS v4.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Use @custom-variant to define custom variants for Tailwind CSS v4.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Use @utility to define custom utility classes for Tailwind CSS v4.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Use @variant to define custom variants for Tailwind CSS v4.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Use @source to tell Tailwind CSS where to scan for class names.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Use @config to load a Tailwind CSS configuration file.

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Use @plugin to register a Tailwind CSS plugin.
